content.title: American Airlines Flight Cancellations Persist as Rivals Move Past Winter Storm
content.summary: Airlines have largely recovered from winter storm Fern’s snow and ice, but American Airlines continues to struggle.  As of midafternoon, more than 950 American flights scheduled for Tuesday have been scrapped.  Regional carrier PSA Airlines, which operates American-branded flights, has shed over a quarter of its schedule.

content.title: American Airlines, JetBlue Shares Are Dropping After Earnings
content.summary: American Airlines  stock slid early Tuesday as the carrier’s fourth-quarter earnings fell short of expectations but management provided upbeat guidance for 2026.  The carrier reported adjusted earnings per share of 16 cents from revenue of $14 billion.  Wall Street was looking for earnings of 37 cents per share, while revenue was in line with expectations.

content.title: CEOs Flag Jittery US Consumers as Global Tensions Intensify
content.summary: Delta Air Lines Inc. said geopolitical uncertainty is clouding its profit outlook, while United Airlines Holdings Inc. warned that global tensions are beginning to hit some travel demand.  Executives at consumer staples companies Procter & Gamble Co. and McCormick & Co. said shoppers remain cautious.
